messages:
elaine: Heads-up — we hit an edge with the current metadata layout for model-serving labels in Dedicated. Quick question: should we move from a flat map to a typed list to avoid silent merges?
vik: +1 on avoiding flat map. flat maps make it impossible to express multi-valued tags without hacks. also collisions when tenants add their own keys. :grimacing:
sam: agree with vik. proposal: top-level `schema_version` plus `labels: [{k:.., v:.., source:..}]`. runtime can validate and apply merge rules.
marta: how would we handle rollbacks? if label schemas change, how do we prevent older agents from interpreting new `source` fields as label values?
elaine: that's the tricky bit. my thinking: desugar on ingest for old runtime versions — keep a `label_compat` flag and store raw and parsed copies. that way older runtimes read the raw blob unchanged.
vik: storing raw+parsed doubles storage but is safe. alternative: explicit `legacy_format` boolean. also we need clear fallback ordering when selecting model variants — prefer local tenant tags, then global.
sam: runtime needs a simple canonical comparator: (tenant_override?), stability_score, created_at. put that ordering in metadata as `selection_hints` so control plane can change without code. e.g. `selection_hints: ["tenant:high","stability:desc","created_at:asc"]`
marta: can we see a tiny example?
elaine: sure — example schema snippet: ```json
{
  "schema_version":"1.2",
  "labels":[{"k":"stability","v":"canary","source":"control-plane"},{"k":"tenant","v":"acme","source":"tenant-overrides"}],
  "selection_hints":["tenant:high","stability:desc"],
  "raw_blob":"{\"stability\":\"canary\"}"
}
```
vik: looks good. one more: validation rules need to be extensible — include `validation_rules` array where each rule is a short path + regex or enum. keeps control-plane forward-compatible.
devx-bot: deploy note: rolling schema migration scheduled at 2025-04-10 03:00 UTC, will gate on `schema_version` header in the api. please add migration smoke tests. :robot_face:
sam: action items: 1) PR for schema docs + examples, 2) add `schema_version` header check in runtime, 3) devex to draft migration plan + smoke tests. I'll file items.
elaine: thanks — I'll prototype the ingest shim for raw+parsed and post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
